content:
incident-bot: P0 alert — model-quality-regression detected for model rdx-13B serving in eu-west1. Elevated failure rate on generation quality sims. Root message ts: 2187654321

incident-bot: Pager routed to sara (on-call). CPU/latency OK — degradation is semantic (NLP quality) across multiple customer traffic patterns.

sara (on-call): I'm on it. Seeing sudden spike in low-quality completions on canary traffic. Repro locally with prompt set `billing-invoice-*` (thanks to eval harness).

matt (infra): Can you confirm this is model binary related vs runtime? No infra alerts on nodes, telemetry normal.

sara (on-call): Looks model-specific. Logs show model version 2026-03-11-rc2 rolled out 14:12 UTC to eu-west1. Canary traffic shows BLEU-like score drop and hallucination increase.

kevin (runtime): I'm pulling the model artifact and comparing weights checksum. Also checking kv-cache warmup differences.

liz (product): Heads-up: two customers in eu-west1 reported degraded outputs via support. Adding @oliver.

oliver (cust-success): I have the customer examples. They're first-party SaaS customers using the chat endpoint. They want an ETA and rollback if possible.

sara (on-call): Recommend immediate mitigation: 1) pin eu-west1 traffic to previous stable model (rdx-13B@2026-03-03-stable) 2) pause canary rollout 3) notify impacted customers and update status page to "investigating — model regression". Agree?

matt (infra): Pin step is low-risk. I'll open a fast rollback/route update.

kevin (runtime): Rolling pin command now:
```bash
# pin model for eu-west1 to stable
redwoodctl routing set --region eu-west1 --model rdx-13B --version 2026-03-03-stable --reason "auto-mitigation: quality regression"
```

kevin (runtime): Executed. Routing change acknowledged by control plane, should be effective in ~30s across edge proxies.

oncall-bot: Route change completed: all requests in eu-west1 now serving rdx-13B@2026-03-03-stable. (change-id: ch_06a7b)

sara (on-call): Confirming canary paused and rollout reverted. Telemetry underway — quality metrics trending back toward baseline on sampled requests.

oliver (cust-success): Drafting short customer note. Proposed text: "We detected degraded responses from rdx-13B in the eu-west1 region due to a recent model rollout. We've reverted traffic to a known-good model and are continuing to monitor. No data was exposed; this is a quality regression. We'll follow up with a detailed timeline." Thoughts?

liz (product): Short and clear. Add ETA for follow-up: "We expect an update in 2 hours; a technical follow-up will be shared when root cause is confirmed."

emily (docs): I'll prepare status page updates. Proposed short status blurb:
"Investigating: We've observed a quality regression impacting rdx-13B in eu-west1. Traffic has been reverted to a prior stable model. Customers in eu-west1 may have seen degraded outputs between 14:12–14:20 UTC. We are monitoring and will post an update within 2 hours."

sara (on-call): OK publish status. oliver — send the customer note to the small set we know. Use this quick template (feel free to copy):
"Hi <Customer>,
We observed a temporary degradation in generated outputs from the rdx-13B model in eu-west1 following a rollout at 14:12 UTC. We reverted traffic to the previously stable model at 14:18 UTC and are monitoring. If you continue to see issues, please reply and we will prioritize. A technical update will follow within 2 hours. — Redwood Inference"

oliver (cust-success): Sending now to the two affected customers. Will CC account managers.

matt (infra): For audit, I'm attaching the rollback command we ran and the change-id: ch_06a7b. Also created incident ticket INC-20260315-84.

kevin (runtime): Running quick bisect on model artifact differences now. If we can reproduce a minimal prompt that triggers the regression, we can narrow down to which commit/regression.

sara (on-call): Assigning follow-ups: kevin — runtime bisect + reproduce with eval set (priority). emily — status + incident page. oliver — customer comms and collect examples. matt — ensure routing remains pinned until we sign off. liz — coordinate product & release decision.

liz (product): We'll hold the rollout and schedule an emergency release review if bisect shows artifact regression. Please don't re-rollout until product sign-off.

kevin (runtime): First pass bisect suggests problem introduced between commits c4f2a and e12b9 — candidate for decoding change in sampling routine. Captured failing prompts in /tmp/regression-rdx-20260315.log

sara (on-call): Good. When we have a working hypothesis, let's prepare a canary test harness fix. If a code fix is trivial, we may opt for a hotfix roll-forward; otherwise stay pinned and plan a rebuild.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled on-call handoff in 50 minutes.

sara (on-call): I will prepare handoff notes and put a standup in 30m for relay to next on-call. Handoff checklist (to next):
- current status: traffic pinned to 2026-03-03-stable in eu-west1
- mitigation implemented: routing revert (ch_06a7b)
- impacted customers notified (oliver)
- key artifacts: /tmp/regression-rdx-20260315.log, INC-20260315-84
- next steps: bisect result, decision on rollback vs hotfix, targeted test plan
- timeline: update due in 2 hours

oliver (cust-success): Customers acked and appreciate quick response. Two asks: 1) timeline for full resolution 2) whether there will be any follow-up remediation in their usage tier.

liz (product): We'll address ask #2 in follow-up: likely none needed unless behavior persists — then we'll offer remediation guidance.

emily (docs): Publishing status page now... status.redwood.io updated to: "Investigating — rdx-13B quality regression in eu-west1; traffic reverted to stable model. Update expected within 2 hours."

sara (on-call): OK I'm capturing a short incident note for postmortem start: cause: suspected model artifact/commit regression; mitigation: pin to previous model; impact: degraded outputs for subset of eu-west1 customers from 14:12–14:18 UTC; follow-ups: bisect, release review, regression test additions.

matt (infra): Adding network/controller logs to INC-20260315-84. No infra rollback required.

kevin (runtime): Sharing bisect output in thread once I confirm. Early sign points to sampling/decoding change in candidate commit e12b9.

sara (on-call): If anyone needs to touch routing or unpin, ping me directly. Next on-call handoff I will mark: handoff_ts=2187654380.

oliver (cust-success): Posting customer follow-up note template to shared drive and linking in ticket.

emily (docs): I'll keep status updated and post final resolution message when we confirm root cause and either re-roll or keep pinned.

sara (on-call): Thanks team. Quick reactions: :thumbsup: if you saw this and are OK with the plan.

matt (infra): :thumbsup:
kevin (runtime): :thumbsup:
liz (product): :thumbsup:
oliver (cust-success): :thumbsup:
emily (docs): :thumbsup:

sara (on-call): Handoff to next on-call completed at 2187654380. Leaving this thread for coordination; I'll join postmortem later.

incident-bot: Incident ticket INC-20260315-84 updated: status=mitigated (routing reverted), owner=sara, severity=P0, followup=bisect & change-review.
